device.fullMixOnly: This source will be included in the Full Mix only

everything.label: Everything
everything.description: All sound from the selected output devices, including music and voice chat.

gameAndVoiceChat.label: Game and Voice Chat
gameAndVoiceChat.description: The game plus Discord and TeamSpeak.

appAudio.title: App Audio
appAudio.description: Records these apps together with the game's audio, each on its own track when Separate Audio Tracks is on. Display recordings already include all desktop audio, so apps are not added there.

separateTracks.label: Separate Audio Tracks
separateTracks.description: Saves each audio source as its own track, next to the full mix.

trackLimitWarning.message: You have selected more than {{max}} audio sources. Only the first {{max}} will be saved as separate audio tracks. Any additional sources will be recorded in the Full Mix only.

actions.toggleRecordingHint: Records the focused game, or your display if no game is focused. Stops any active recording.

broker.outdated: The helper for hotkeys over games running as administrator is out of date. Updating it needs administrator permission.
broker.missing: Hotkeys do not reach games that run as administrator. Installing the helper fixes this and needs administrator permission.

inputGroup.message: Hotkeys only work while a game is focused. To use them everywhere, run {{command}} in a terminal, then log out and back in.
